name: Regex Tester
tagline: Test regular expressions against any text
description: Test and debug regular expressions live. See all matches, match count, and character spans highlighted. Supports flags: case-insensitive (i), multiline (m), dotall (s). No external tools needed.

inputs.name: text
inputs.label: Test Text
inputs.placeholder: Paste the text to test against...

expert_defs.name: regex_tester_test
expert_defs.description: Tests a regex pattern against text and returns all matches with their positions. Params: pattern (regex string), text (test string), flags (combination of i=ignorecase, m=multiline, s=dotall). Returns JSON with output_type json.
code: spans = [{'start': m.start(), 'end': m.end(), 'match': m.group()} for m in re.finditer(pattern, text, f)]

conceptTexts: Plugin: Regex Tester (id: regex-tester). Expert regex_tester_test tests regex patterns against text. Params: pattern (regex), text (test input), flags (i/m/s). Returns {output_type: 'json', data: {is_match, count, matches, spans}}.
